name: Sarnath the Doomed
summary: Sarnath the Doomed was a city that stood in the land of Mnar when mankind was young, recalled by the narrator — together with Ib, carven of gray stone before mankind existed — as he confronted the incomprehensible antiquity of the nameless city.
description:
Sarnath enters the record only as a measure of age. Grasping at the vast and inarticulate antiquity of the nameless city before him, the narrator reached for the oldest names he knew — and found that even these fell short of it.

Of the city itself nothing further is told here: neither the doom its name carries, nor what became of Ib, the gray-stone city that shared the land of Mnar with it.
